    pts=[]
    for s in ss:
        pts.append((s[0],s[1],s[2]));pts.append((s[3],s[4],s[5]))
    if not pts: print('no pts');return
    us=[dot(p,a) for p in pts];vs=[dot(p,b) for p in pts]
    umin,umax=min(us),max(us);vmin,vmax=min(vs),max(vs)
    scale=(width-2*pad)/(umax-umin)
    height=max(1,int((vmax-vmin)*scale)+2*pad)
    if height>4000:

    print(out,an,bn,'extent',umax-umin,vmax-vmin,'size',width,height,'scale',scale)
    img=bytearray([255])*(width*height)
    def drawline(x0,y0,x1,y1):
        # coords in image
        dx=abs(x1-x0);dy=abs(y1-y0);sx=1 if x0<x1 else -1;sy=1 if y0<y1 else -1;err=dx-dy
        while True:
            if 0<=x0<width and 0<=y0<height: img[y0*width+x0]=0
            if x0==x1 and y0==y1: break
            e2=2*err
            if e2>-dy:err-=dy;x0+=sx
            if e2<dx:err+=dx;y0+=sy
    for s in ss:
        u0=dot((s[0],s[1],s[2]),a);v0=dot((s[0],s[1],s[2]),b)
        u1=dot((s[3],s[4],s[5]),a);v1=dot((s[3],s[4],s[5]),b)

        drawline(x0,y0,x1,y1)

def write_png(path,w,h,img):
    def chunk(t,d):
        c=struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d
        return c+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
    raw=bytearray()

        raw.append(0);raw.extend(img[y*w:(y+1)*w])
    png=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
    png+=chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,0,0,0,0))
    png+=chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(bytes(raw),9))
    png+=chunk(b'IEND',b'')
    open(path,'wb').write(png)
